consistency.title: Consistency Score
consistency.tooltipScoreExplanation: Your score (0–100) reflects how consistently you log food and hit your calorie and protein targets. Each day you track and hit your goals earns a higher daily score, which is averaged across your selected date range.
consistency.tooltipTodayExplanation: Shows whether you have logged any food today. Log at least one meal to mark today as tracked.
consistency.tooltipConsistencyExplanation: The number of days you logged food out of the total days in your selected range. Missing days count as zero toward your score.
consistency.tooltipCaloriesExplanation: Days where your logged calories were within a healthy range of your daily calorie goal. Hitting 80–110% of your target earns full points.
consistency.tooltipProteinExplanation: Days where your logged protein met or exceeded your daily protein goal. Protein is the most important macro for body composition.

progressCard.title: Progress
progressCard.setWeightGoal: Set your weight goal in Profile to see progress.
progressCard.setStartingWeight: Set your starting weight in Profile to see progress.
progressCard.statProgressExplanation: The total weight you have lost (or gained) since your starting weight. A downward arrow means you are losing weight; an upward arrow means you have gained since the start.
progressCard.statMomentumExplanation: Your current rate of weight change based on the last 14 days of logged check-ins, expressed in pounds per week. The subtitle shows how closely your calorie intake has matched your daily goal.
progressCard.statTimelineExplanation: How many days ahead of or behind your original plan you are, calculated from your cumulative calorie surplus or deficit. Being ahead means your eating habits are putting you on track to reach your goal sooner.
progressCard.statTargetExplanation: Your starting weight versus your current weight, and the projected date you will reach your goal weight based on your recent calorie tracking and pace.
